units.source_text: 正在骚乱之际，夕雾大将遣使送信来了。

en.t: Amid the commotion, General Yugiri sent a messenger with a letter.

units.source_text: 此时老夫人尚未完全昏迷，隐约闻得有信送来，心知夕雾今夜又不会来了。

en.t: At this time the old lady had not yet completely lost consciousness, and when she faintly heard that a letter had arrived, she knew in her heart that Yugiri would not come again tonight.

units.source_text: 她想：“我的女儿何其命苦，想不到做了世人的笑柄！

en.t: She thought, "How cruel my daughter's fate is; who would have imagined she would become the laughingstock of the world!

units.source_text: 连我也留了一封可耻的信在别人手中！”

en.t: Even I have left a shameful letter in another person's hands!"

units.source_text: 百感交集，痛苦之极，就此与世长辞。

en.t: Overwhelmed by countless feelings and suffering to the utmost, she passed from this world then and there.

units.source_text: 这般情景，悲、恨等字都不够形容了！

en.t: Such a scene could not be described by words like grief or resentment.

units.source_text: 她以前常常被鬼怪侵扰，有好几次死而复苏。

en.t: In the past she had often been troubled by spirits, and several times she had seemed to die and then revive.

units.source_text: 僧众以为此次也照老例，就加紧诵念祈祷，岂知一去不返了。

en.t: The monks thought this time would follow the old pattern too, so they intensified their chanting and prayers, never knowing that once she had gone she would not return.

units.source_text: 公主要跟母亲同去，躺在遗骸旁边哭泣。

en.t: The princess wanted to go with her mother, and lay beside the remains weeping.

units.source_text: 侍女们用人世常理来劝慰她：“今已无可奈何了！

en.t: The waiting women tried to console her with the ordinary truths of human life: "There is nothing more that can be done now!

units.source_text: 凡人走上了大限之路，是决不会再回来的。

en.t: When a person has set out on the road of their final limit, they will certainly never return.

units.source_text: 公主虽然舍不得老太太，有何办法可得称心如意呢？”

en.t: Though Your Highness cannot bear to part from the old lady, what means are there to make everything as you wish?"

units.source_text: 有的强要扶她回去，说道：“这样反而不好！

en.t: Some tried forcibly to support her and take her back, saying, "This will only make things worse!

units.source_text: 会使老太太在冥司路上增加罪过呢！

en.t: It will add to the old lady's sins on the road to the realm of the dead!
Please go back over there and rest."

units.source_text: 但公主的身体缩成一团，已经失却知觉了。

en.t: But the princess's body had curled into a ball, and she had already lost consciousness.

units.source_text: 僧众拆毁了祈祷坛，纷纷散去，只有几个陪夜僧人留着。

en.t: The monks dismantled the prayer altar and dispersed one after another, leaving only a few monks to keep vigil through the night.

units.source_text: 现在已经无可挽回，那景象真好凄凉！

en.t: Now nothing could be undone, and the sight was truly desolate.
